title: Accordion item
summary: One collapsible section on a native details element, with an animated panel where the browser supports it.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Controls in the header, beside the chevron, that do not toggle the section (for example a Re-check button). They sit outside the toggle, so they are separate tab stops.

cssProperties.name: --pk-accordion-actions
cssProperties.description: Header room reserved for the actions slot; the element sets it from the slotted width.

a11y: Native details and summary semantics with a 44px header; the chevron is decorative. The animation is skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

examples.title: Header action
examples.html: <pk-accordion-item heading="Checks" open><pk-button slot="actions" size="sm">Re-check</pk-button>Last run passed.</pk-accordion-item>
